t: This is Madame Tussauds in London, the wax museum. It was founded by Marie Tussaud, a French artist who was known for her wax sculptures. The museum she established in London carries her name, and it's the best-known part of her legacy. She lived from 1761 to 1850. I don't have more detail on the building or its history to share here, but the name over the door tells you who started it.
